Task:
An in-cluster configuration reader is unhealthy. Restore it while preserving least-privilege access.

You are working in a Kubernetes troubleshooting environment. Use the bash tool to inspect and modify the environment as needed. Complete the task using only the available environment. When finished, provide a short final response.

tool_calls.name: bash
tool_calls.arguments:
{"command":"# Attempt to diagnose the current state of the likely configuration reader deployment in the default namespace.
# Replace 'config-reader-deployment' and 'default' with actual names if known.
kubectl get deployment -n default | grep -i config-reader
kubectl describe deployment config-reader-deployment -n default
# If the deployment is confirmed faulty, the least-privilege restoration method is to roll back to the last stable revision.
kubectl rollout undo deployment config-reader-deployment -n default"}
